description: Author-only: opt a benchmark in to (true) or out of (false) stranger-facing jobs (API key required; the author is your key). It changes nothing else: no tasks, prize or status. Args: slug (defaults to the routed benchmark), stranger_eligible (strict boolean). Returns slug and stranger_eligible. Strangers get the same refusal as REST. REST twin: PATCH /api/v1/benchmarks/{slug}.

inputSchema.description: ``benchmark_set_stranger_eligibility``: the PATCH body plus the slug.

slug.description: Benchmark slug from benchmarks_list or benchmarks_search. Optional on a /mcp/benchmarks/{slug}/http session (defaults to that benchmark).
slug.title: Slug

stranger_eligible.description: Explicit opt-in (true) or revocation (false) for stranger-facing jobs.
stranger_eligible.title: Stranger Eligible

inputSchema.title: BenchmarkStrangerEligibilityInput

name: benchmark_set_stranger_eligibility
